title: NO MERCY FOR THE PLAN — 60-SECOND TEST
notes: Original fictional heist thriller test. Hard-edged dialogue, intimidating posture, sharp reactions, and cinematic staging. Keep it fictional and non-graphic.

scenes.action: The Planner leans over the table, plants both hands on the map, then slowly points at the target. Ghost stands rigid with clenched fists and a cold stare.
scenes.dialogue: Planner: No speeches. No heroes. We go in, we take control, we disappear. Ghost: And if someone gets in our way? Planner: Then they learn to move.
scenes.caption: TONIGHT, THE RULES CHANGE

scenes.action: Ghost turns sharply toward the security monitor, shoulders squared and chin lowered. Vale steps forward with a hard stare and points directly at Ghost.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Hands where I can see them. Ghost: You first. Captain Vale: You think you're in charge? Ghost: No. I think you're late.
scenes.caption: WRONG ROOM. WRONG NIGHT.

scenes.action: The Planner stays unnervingly still beside the vault, head slightly tilted. Vale takes one tense step back, shoulders raised, then freezes.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: You have nowhere to go. Planner: That's what people say when they have run out of ideas. Captain Vale: You're bluffing. Planner: Then stop looking at the exit.
scenes.caption: THE SILENCE IS THE THREAT

scenes.action: Ghost bursts into a sharp sprint, twists back over one shoulder, and throws a defiant hand gesture. Vale lunges forward to chase, body pitched aggressively forward.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: Stop! Ghost: Make me. Captain Vale: You cannot outrun the whole city. Ghost: I only need to outrun you.
scenes.caption: DON'T BLINK

scenes.action: Ghost slams a palm onto the table and leans in, jaw set. The Planner does not flinch; he slowly raises one finger and holds eye contact.
scenes.dialogue: Ghost: We had one job. One. Planner: Lower your voice. Ghost: Give me one reason. Planner: Because the next decision is the one that decides who walks out.
scenes.caption: ANGER IS NOT A PLAN

scenes.action: The Planner faces the skyline with a calm, squared stance. Ghost turns toward the camera with a hard, unblinking stare while Vale stands behind them, tense and ready to move.
scenes.dialogue: Captain Vale: This ends now. Planner: Everything ends. The question is who gets to choose. Ghost: Then choose carefully. Planner: I already did.
scenes.caption: THIS WAS ONLY THE FIRST MOVE
